stories.publisher: Avinash Benki, Prasanjith Pasunuti, Sutanshu Saksena Raj, Parijat Chatterjee, Nayanjit Sarkar, Daksh Maan
stories.description: arXiv:2610.15373v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We adapted Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B for eight Indian languages without changing its backbone architecture. We expanded the vocabulary in place from 131,072 to 163,072 entries using continued byte-pair encoding and AdaptMix rebalancing, reducing tokens per word by 38.6%. We initialized new input and output rows by averaging their original constituent rows, then trained them on 90% Indic and 10% English text before updating the backbone.
